name: stable-otp-registration-responsive-ui
changes: Customer and listener registration are idempotent: a slow/repeated profile submit resumes the account created from the same verified OTP instead of reporting that the phone verification was already used
Returning numbers continue to open the existing role account with password login until that account is permanently deleted
New listener accounts remain locked to mandatory voice verification and admin approval before the listener workspace becomes available
Customer listener profiles use a wider responsive desktop/tablet layout with cleaner banner/avatar/actions/posts and stable navigation
Customer desktop/tablet navigation is moved out of the floating mobile dock and into a sticky top navigation row
Listener desktop/tablet login and signed-in views are rebalanced to prevent clipped artwork and oversized empty areas while preserving the <=700px mobile layout
Dark inherited auth checkboxes/inputs are overridden with accessible light-theme controls across customer and listener authentication
Decorative background glows are removed from primary app surfaces to reduce visual noise and improve consistency across screen sizes
Cache/version identifiers are bumped to 8.9.16 so stale 8.9.15 layouts are replaced after deployment
